entries.test: TASK-006 timed Start/Pause/Resume/Finish action hierarchy > AC-R006-01 EMOM and AMRAP Start follows the work and prescription and precedes coaching on the real /workout route
entries.note: Round 7 look, same asserted behaviour: one [data-timed-actions] slot ('after-work') holding only the primary Start, after the movement list and every prescription reading (.clr-movement-identity, [data-movement-detail]) and before the card’s one Coaching and notes disclosure; running, Pause and the format’s Finish early in the same slot. Reads Round 7’s card (.clr-timed-flow) and words (Start EMOM, Start AMRAP; lists ‘Movements in this EMOM/AMRAP’). Round 7 draws no ‘15s rest at the end of each minute’ line nor an ‘Each round:’ card, so the two instances read Round 7’s own last prescription lines instead: the EMOM’s ‘Min 2 · 10 reps’ minute line and the AMRAP round’s last movement. The build’s ‘coaching is the card’s last element’ is read as ‘one Coaching and notes disclosure, after the slot’ (Round 7’s card ends with the shell’s completion control). The card’s disclosure is found by its TASK-005 accessible name (‘Coaching and notes — EMOM: kb swing, burpee’, ‘— AMRAP: kb swing, burpee’, ‘— FOR TIME: wall ball’, ‘— LADDER: push up, burpee’), and the card still holds exactly one.

entries.test: TASK-006 timed Start/Pause/Resume/Finish action hierarchy > AC-R006-01 the long ladder keeps its Start near the top, after its identity and cap and before the repetitive rounds, with no second Start
entries.note: Round 7 look, same asserted behaviour: the ladder’s slot is ‘top’, after its header (LADDER badge) and Round 7’s identity-and-cap line ‘12 rounds · 07:00 cap’, before the compact summary and all twelve rounds (‘Prescribed ladder rounds’), nothing of the work before it, one Start, not sticky or fixed; running, Pause and Finish in the same top slot. The build’s structure meta ‘7 MIN CAP · LADDER UP’ and timing line are Round 7’s single meta line.

entries.test: TASK-006 timed Start/Pause/Resume/Finish action hierarchy > AC-C17-01 every timed action row is the shared responsive full-width slot, after the work and before coaching, and the ladder alone takes the top slot
entries.note: Round 7 look, same asserted behaviour and the same declared recipe, read from Round 7’s one declaring file (src/styles/timed-workout.css, not the build’s refinements/presentation.css): grid, repeat(auto-fit, minmax(0, 1fr)), gap var(--spacing-300), cells and buttons width 100%, no px; computed display grid; each control a clr-btn in its own clr-bleed cell; after the work for every format but the ladder (‘top’). For Time’s ‘The work:’ label does not exist in Round 7; its Start is asserted after every For Time movement and prescription reading. The card’s disclosure is found by its TASK-005 accessible name (‘Coaching and notes — EMOM: kb swing, burpee’, ‘— AMRAP: kb swing, burpee’, ‘— FOR TIME: wall ball’, ‘— LADDER: push up, burpee’), and the card still holds exactly one.

entries.test: TASK-006 timed Start/Pause/Resume/Finish action hierarchy > AC-C18-01 running controls are a secondary Pause and the format's primary Finish or Finish early, and paused controls a secondary Resume in Pause's place
entries.note: Round 7 look, same asserted behaviour: ready [Start, primary]; running [Pause secondary, Finish/Finish early primary]; paused [Resume secondary, same Finish]; focus kept on the one lead control through Start → Pause → Resume; finishLabel’s six readings unchanged. The windowless AMRAP and EMOM are mounted through BlockSlot under the product presentation (Round 7’s route renderer) and say Finish. The build’s direct mounts of its exported TimedWorkoutActions (ended draws nothing; a schedule with no Pause draws nothing) are read through the flow: after Finish the slot is gone. Round 7’s action row is internal to TimedWorkoutFlow and Round 7 draws no schedule in it (a scheduled ladder stays LadderBlock), so the schedule sub-assertion has no Round 7 counterpart.

entries.test: TASK-006 timed Start/Pause/Resume/Finish action hierarchy > AC-C18-01 Pause freezes the section clock and its cap while the workout clock runs on, and Resume keeps the active time and the remaining window
entries.note: Round 7 look, same asserted behaviour and the same arithmetic (session clock 01:00 → 03:30 while the section is paused). Readouts are Round 7’s timer-frame digits; phase words are its caption (Paused, Elapsed, Minute N of 10). Round 7 draws no ‘Cap in mm:ss’ line, so ‘the cap holds’ is asserted by pausing past what was left of the cap (For Time: 900 s; ladder: 400 s against 320 left) and finding the clock still paused, never ‘Cap reached’; the stored pausedAt is the build’s assertion unchanged. The EMOM’s minute is held by Round 7’s Now marker staying on minute 1’s movement and its seconds left (the caption says Paused while paused), then ‘Minute 2 of 10’ with Now on the next movement after Resume. Final session time 36:15 is the same sum over the reordered steps.

entries.test: TASK-006 timed Start/Pause/Resume/Finish action hierarchy > AC-C18-01 Finish ends each format's attempt where it stands — a paused attempt at its pause — and records nothing the format did not already observe
entries.note: Round 7 look, same asserted behaviour: For Time paused at 40 s and finished later reads 00:40 and ‘Finished’ (Round 7’s caption for the build’s ‘Finished under cap’); AMRAP Finish early settles its window at 06:25 left (Round 7 draws the window left, the build ‘01:35 on the clock’) and holds it; EMOM Finish early: the build’s exact note ‘Finished early, in minute 3 of 10. Continue when you are ready.’, held as time passes; ladder 03:20 and its log asks Work completed. Logs are closed with Round 7’s ‘Close log’; the forward action records exactly the build’s four outcomes.

entries.test: TASK-006 timed Start/Pause/Resume/Finish action hierarchy > AC-R006-02 the section's Finish stays distinct from Finish workout: ending a block neither completes nor leaves the workout
entries.note: Round 7 look, same asserted behaviour: Finish workout lives in the section navigation; each section Finish lives in its card; ending all four leaves the route on /workout with nothing recorded or completed; Finish workout then completes once. Logs closed with Round 7’s ‘Close log’.

entries.test: TASK-006 timed Start/Pause/Resume/Finish action hierarchy > JOURNEY-006 recovery: a paused section comes back paused after close and reopen, and a reached cap offers no Resume
entries.note: Round 7 look, same asserted behaviour: after close and a ten-minute reopen For Time and EMOM come back [Resume, Finish / Finish early] at 00:45 and PAUSED; the never-started AMRAP stored nothing; Resume runs on (00:50) and clears the stored pausedAt; the ladder ran on to its cap: no controls, 07:00, ‘Cap reached’.
